newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Klima says Blair gives people new hope.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Klima says Blair gives people new hope.

text.p: Austrian Chancellor Viktor Klima on Friday welcomed Tony Blair's election as Britain's new prime minister, calling his landslide victory a "sign of the strength of Social Democracy".

"Tony Blair gives the people of Great Britain, who were disillusioned by the policies of the conservatives, new hope for a social, modern and human future," Klima, the head of Austria's ruling Social Democratic Party, said in a statement.
Klima added he hoped the new Labour government would support Austria's efforts to put employment issues at the top of the European Union's agenda.
